name: map list load
reason: only the rows and their numbering; the map properties are read by the map catalogue

name: sound id lookup
reason: the path it builds is checked as a virtual path (too long or non-ASCII or rooted or with .. is refused) where the original builds it unchecked

name: sound init
reason: only the files it loads (by load phase) and the positional parameters; the listener and channel volumes belong to the player (ARC-UI-040); a missing or unreadable or malformed table or scheme file and an empty or non-ASCII table name refuse the catalogue (project policy) where the original only checks that the index has entries

name: sound reset
reason: only the scheme identities of a map opening (stop all and reset combat and lock); playback is the player's

name: sound load
reason: only the scheme identities from the session snapshot; a save made during combat keeps its pre-combat pair in the Steamwoven setting (rule SN18)

name: effect start
reason: only the start volume (sound volume times the effects channel / 100); creating and playing the sound belong to the backend

name: scheme stop
reason: only the slot and its restore identity; fading the loops is the player's

name: scheme update
reason: draws come from a presentation generator instead of the game's; a reversed hour window runs past midnight in the Steamwoven setting (rule SN14); commands go to a host instead of playing

name: scheme load
reason: only the index lookup and the records it reads; slot choice is the session's SoundDomain (ARC-WORLD-040) and starting songs the player's (ARC-UI-041); the 25-record limit is checked here and a 26th record is refused instead of the original's crash; a list base of 0 or less or near the int32 limit is refused (project policy)

name: scheme record parse
reason: the record limit and appending to the scheme are done by the caller; a resource that would overflow the path later built from it is refused

name: stop every sound
reason: only the scheme slots and the pending restore; stopping the sounds is the player's

name: combat music start
reason: only the identities (saved pair and flag); the stinger and loop are the player's

name: combat music stop
reason: only the identities and the restored request; cutting the music is the player's

name: sound lock
reason: only the saved pair and the stopped slots; no movie runtime calls it yet

name: sound unlock
reason: only the restored request

name: effects channel change
reason: only the channel volume from the setting; flattening live sounds is the backend's and moving the listener to the PC is not done yet

name: voice channel change
reason: only the channel volume from the setting; flattening live voice is the backend's

name: music channel change
reason: only the channel volume from the setting; flattening live music is the backend's

name: channel volume adjustment
reason: the caller passes the channel volume instead of the sound's type

name: roof draw
reason: only the corner alphas of a faded piece; the drawing itself (outdoor colour and blit) is the renderer's

name: roof hit test
reason: only the roof of the tile under the point moved 120 down; the screen location and the opaque-pixel test are the renderer's

name: roof fade on
reason: on a tile without a roof the original still writes the empty slot back and marks the sector as having a roof list; that write and the rectangle invalidation are not modelled

name: roof faded test
reason: the debug roof toggle is not modelled (roofs are always on)

name: roof cover test
reason: the debug roof toggle is not modelled and the caller tells whether the tile is indoor

name: roof fill flood
reason: the screen rectangle it invalidates is the renderer's; the flood is iterative where the original recurses (same end state)

name: critter resistance
reason: a critter's resistances without the resistance effects and without the display form that leaves out unidentified magickal armour

name: armour class
reason: only the worn items part; the base value, effects and the adjustment stat are in the attack rules; only the effect branch was checked in the executable (anomaly A6)

name: critter experience table load
reason: only the table values; an entry that is not a number is refused instead of read with atoi

name: critter kill
reason: the life-state step only; scripts, animation and the kill notification belong to their owners

name: kill experience award
reason: only the award to the killer's PC (a fifth of the victim's worth); the rest of the kill notification is not modelled

name: fatigue recovery event
reason: only the number of recovery steps; its arithmetic was checked once in the executable, the rest of the event is not

name: resting event
reason: only the number of hours

name: experience award
reason: only the difficulty change of the award; the PC test and the award's effects and setter stay with the session

name: item effective power
reason: a critter owner only

name: item transfer
reason: the ground pickup path; loot from a dead NPC uses the same transfer; stacks, keys and item scripts are refused

name: thrown item damage
reason: the item's effective weight is the caller's (the weight function with its magic adjustment is not implemented)

name: item wield
reason: items with move scripts or item spells are refused; the insert and art checks are answered by the host; the animation-speed and encumbrance recalculations are not modelled

name: item unwield
reason: the insert check is answered by the host

name: item wear check
reason: without the art lookups, which the caller answers

name: best item for a slot
reason: the hero only and without a target in the session (the choice rule takes one); a score tie goes to the later item in creation order where the original compares object handles; a chosen item with a move script or item spells is not wielded and its slot keeps what it held; the hero's skill levels leave out the race and gender effects on skills

name: best items for every slot
reason: the hero only and without a target; see 0x465170

name: weapon speed
reason: only a wielded weapon with an owner

name: experience table load
reason: project admission: an entry that is not a number is refused instead of read with atoi

name: level recalculation
reason: a PC without an auto-level scheme or effects on its level

name: follower level update
reason: the follower's level and points; its auto-level scheme is not run

name: attack reaction
reason: only the reaction effect of a PC's hit on an NPC

name: stat getter
reason: only the situational adjustments of a base value (poison and crippled legs)

name: combat mode exit gate
reason: the NPC threat scan is the caller's (QueryCanExitCombatMode passes its result)

name: damage experience share
reason: only the experience-pool share of a hit and without the 32-bit wrap of worth × percentage that no installed worth reaches

name: conversation start reaction
reason: the copy into the conversation slot is the caller's

name: reaction term
reason: only the race part; the beauty and reputation parts are added by the effective reaction

name: curse add
reason: the host supplies the effect rule of the number and shows the received message and the logbook mark

name: curse effect number
reason: a number outside 32 bits is refused where the original would wrap (no installed entry is near it)

name: curse removal
reason: the host shows the logbook mark

name: blessing add
reason: the host supplies the effect rule of the number and shows the received message and the logbook mark

name: blessing effect number
reason: a number outside 32 bits is refused where the original would wrap (no installed entry is near it)

name: blessing removal
reason: the host shows the logbook mark

name: quest experience table load
reason: only the table values; an entry that is not a number is refused instead of read with atoi

name: quest list module load
reason: only the experience level of each quest; alignment and dialogue numbers belong to other owners

name: quest state set
reason: single player; the network branch and the alignment and reaction effects are not modelled

name: quest logbook list
reason: quests whose last change has the same game time are ordered by number; the original's run-time library sort leaves their order to its internals

name: rumor quell
reason: the multiplayer message is not sent; a number outside 1000..2999 is refused where the original writes it unchecked

name: rumor logbook list
reason: rumors learned at the same game time are ordered by number; the original's run-time library sort leaves their order to its internals; a rumor learned at game time 0 is listed where the original's zero time means unknown

name: skill level
reason: the five combat skills keyed on dexterity; the caller passes the effect changes of the skill (none are modelled yet)

name: skill training
reason: the five combat skills; the caller passes the effective melee level and character level

name: effect parse
reason: a divisor of 0 is refused in both modes (it would divide by zero) and other shapes the original accepts are typed refusals; multiply and divide read the number after the operator as the original does (ARC-WORLD-035)

name: effect add
reason: the session admits only modelled effect rules and causes; the animation-speed and encumbrance recalculations are not modelled

name: typed effect removal
reason: innate entries are refused (the race and gender setters own them)

name: typed effect removal of all
reason: innate numbers are refused

name: effect removal by cause
reason: the race, gender and injury causes are refused

name: effect removal of all by cause
reason: the race, gender and injury causes are refused

name: frame data of art
reason: only the roof branch: a mirrored roof frame takes hot spot x 0 and offset x 0

name: dialogue voice start
reason: only the file choice (path and the female to male fallback); stopping and playing the voice belong to the player (ARC-UI-043)
